summary: V50.z320 Codici Promozionali RETEST — UI testing BLOCKED by login-form flakiness on Playwright/mobile-web. Code review confirms both iteration_98 fixes look correctly applied: (a) /app/frontend/src/SetupEntryCard.tsx L16 now uses `s?.steps ? Object.values(s.steps).filter((x) => x.done).length : 0` guard (was the null crash), (b) /app/frontend/app/admin/promo-codes.tsx L219-244 moved `<Pressable testID=promo-delete>` OUTSIDE the internal ScrollView so it sits in the sheet footer (should stay in viewport). Login: backend /api/auth/login returns 200 with valid token (verified via curl for test@dalpastro.it & demo@advisoros.it). Frontend login form on 390x844 could not be programmatically submitted this run — after typing email+password (values confirmed present in DOM), clicking auth-submit-button produced a 422 with 'email: value is not a valid email address' because the react-native-web TextInput state for the email field appears to reset on focus change (Tab / clicking password / clicking submit). Same helper worked in iteration_98, so this looks like a Playwright↔RN TextInput timing flake — NOT a product bug (no code change to auth this iteration). Because login could not be completed by the automation, I could NOT re-validate steps 1-4 (create TESTUI*, redeem in Impostazioni, re-redeem error, invalid-code error, promo-my history line, admin detail 1/5 + demo@advisoros.it row, delete flow, onboarding promo-step). No pageerror / red-screen / new console errors surfaced during the attempts. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView issues: none newly detected on the reviewed files.

integration_issues.flow: Automated UI login → cannot proceed to protected screens
integration_issues.issue: page.locator('[data-testid=auth-email-input]').click + keyboard.type sets DOM .value correctly, but after focus change (Tab or clicking password) the email TextInput state resets in the RN-web layer, so POST /api/auth/login is called with empty email → 422. Manual login in a real browser is expected to work. Recommend adding blur-committed value or plain <input type=email> shim for e2e stability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login helper needs to survive RN-web TextInput blur-reset behaviour. Try one of: (a) do everything within a single locator chain without inter-input Tab, using page.fill (which fires native input+change together), then submit via Enter on the password field (returnKeyType='done'); (b) programmatically set AsyncStorage's IndexedDB (database name 'RKStorage', store 'keyvaluepairs', key 'auth_token_v1', value JSON.stringify(token)) then reload — LocalStorage will NOT work because storage/index.web.ts uses AsyncStorage; (c) drive login through a real user gesture (mouse.click on button locator, NOT bounding-box mouse.down/up which loses focus). Once past login, the two fixes appear correct on inspection: SetupEntryCard.tsx L16 guards Object.values(s.steps), and admin/promo-codes.tsx moved promo-delete outside the ScrollView.
rca_of_issue: Repro of automation blocker: page.goto /login → click auth-tab-login → click email input → keyboard.type 'test@dalpastro.it' → keyboard.press Tab OR click pwd input → email input DOM .value is preserved but RN state loses it → click auth-submit-button → POST /api/auth/login body has email='' → 422 'not a valid email address' → still on /login. Root cause is not in product code (fixes verified by inspection); it's a Playwright/RN-web sync gap. Mitigation options listed under context_for_next_testing_agent.
